title: Correct P2 calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute the actual power of lamp L2 as 1.5 W.

title: Correct speed v
description: Essential: Student must determine the rod's constant speed as 7.5 m/s.

title: Correct Ampere force power
description: Essential: Student must find the power of the Ampere force as 6.75 W.

title: Lamp resistances from ratings
description: Important: Student calculates resistances of L1 and L2 using R = U^2/P.

title: Equivalent external resistance
description: Important: Student finds the parallel equivalent resistance of the two lamps.

title: Induced EMF from circuit analysis
description: Important: Student applies Ohm's law and voltage division to find total induced EMF.

title: Energy/power conservation
description: Optional: Student uses conservation of energy to relate mechanical power to electrical powers.

title: Sign/direction error in EMF
description: Pitfall: Student misapplies Lenz's law or sign convention for induced EMF or current.

title: Power formula misuse
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses P = I^2R or P = V^2/R for lamps not at rated voltage.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack proper units or have inconsistent unit conversions.
